channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: RP Voice Chat
item.description: A mod for proximity VoIP. Shout at your friends!

item.title: Axle in blocks
item.description: Allows hide axles, gears and transmission inside bricks, dry stone and wooden planks.

item.title: Auto Walk Extended
item.description: Toggle walking/sprinting. Options to toggle sneaking and automatic climbing.

item.title: Custom Server Patch
item.description: A collection of tweaks for our private server.

item.title: Land Of Estrellas
item.description: The offical modpack of The Land of Estrellas server

item.title: Brighter Blueberries
item.description: Adds vibrant blue back to ripe blueberry bushes.

item.title: Seamless Windows
item.description: An addon for Unleaded Windows that matching window panes into seamless surfaces.

item.title: Fast Ground Placing
item.description: Increases the bulk stack quantity on a few base game resources.

item.title: Panning Machine
item.description: Simple machine for panning

item.title: ooh! shiny!
item.description: Many shiny jewelry

item.title: Furio's Telescope
item.description: (ALPHA) Telescope mod in development

item.title: Leather And Strips
item.description: A collection of medieval-fantasy inspired clothing for everyday use but 70% more leather

item.title: CropsYieldMoreSeeds
item.description: harvestable crops always yield two seeds instead of one and/or none at all

item.title: Nimbus - A Server proxy for Vintagestory.
item.description: Put many backends behind one address, move players between them on demand.

item.title: Daubweave
item.description: A simple patch to buff daub output, and adds an alternative to craft daub blocks!

item.title: Pan Seashells
item.description: A simple patch to add seashells into the panning droptable (for more lime)!

item.title: Fruit Buff
item.description: Changes fruit trees and berry bushes to be much less of a pain to work with!

item.title: Ale Traders
item.description: Adds two alcohol traders, who sell start-up distilling supplies, and buy all your spirits!

item.title: Fish Trader
item.description: Adds the fishmonger trader, who sells fishing supplies and taxidermied catches, and buys fish!

item.title: Animal Trader
item.description: Adds the livestock trader, who sells loads of baby animals, and buys animal products!

item.title: Decal Spraycans
item.description: Patches the Creative decal spraycans to be craftable in Survival!

item.title: Clay Press
item.description: A simple patch to allow the pulverizer to "press" clay into tiles & shingles (no more clayforming)!

item.title: Cupronickel Lanterns
item.description: Adds large and small cupronickel lanterns (coke not included)!

item.title: MORE GOAT
item.description: A simple patch to increase the maximum number of kids goats can have!

item.title: Crush Zinc Nuggets
item.description: A simple patch that lets you (finally) pulverize sphalerite nuggets into powder!

item.title: Locust Drider Classes (Drocust)
item.description: Adds 5 new, exclusive classes to Wulk's Drocust race!

item.title: Recycle Sails
item.description: A simple recipe patch that lets you cut up small and large windmill sails to get your linen back!

item.title: Smash Metal Parts
item.description: A simple recipe patch to smash metal & Jonas parts into cupronickel (with a hammer)!

item.title: Humble Beginnings
item.description: A collection of simple medieval-fantasy inspired clothing for everyday use

item.title: Feed from Seed
item.description: A simple recipe patch that lets you turn your hoard of excess (appropriate) seedbags into food!
